history.summary: Altura is a 2027-TOP EC in Bukit Batok West offering a 4BR at $1.68M / $1,397 psf — an attractive quantum for a brand-new executive condo near the Tengah/Jurong growth corridor. EC mechanics (MOP, citizen-only first hand) plus a 1.34km MRT walk and null URA data temper an otherwise solid entry.
history.rating_rationale: At $1,397 psf and $1.68M quantum, this new EC sits well below comparable D23/Jurong private condo PSF, and ECs structurally re-rate toward private pricing post-MOP — a reliable 5-7yr appreciation driver. Tengah town buildout and JRL (~2028) are real catalysts; the main drags are the 1.34km MRT walk and EC resale restrictions during MOP.
red_flags: 1.34km / 16-min walk to nearest MRT (Tengah Park, JRL)
EC minimum occupation period restricts resale/leasing in early years
No URA series yet — appreciation is inferred from EC re-rating pattern, not transacted
catalysts: Tengah new-town buildout and Jurong Region Line (~2028) within the catchment
Low $1.68M quantum keeps the resale buyer pool deep (HDB upgraders)

history.summary: Altura is a fully-sold 360-unit Bukit Batok West EC (TOP ~Mar 2027) whose 4BR at $1,397 psf looks cheap vs Lumina Grand (~$1,587 psf) and Le Quest resale (~$1,635 psf) — but as a 2026 investment purchase it is structurally broken: EC rules bar subsale before TOP, bar whole-unit rental and resale during the 5yr MOP (to ~Mar 2032), and require the buyer to meet full new-EC eligibility (SC family nucleus, $16k income ceiling, no other property, owner occupation). Zero yield for ~6 years and first legal exit at the very edge of a 5-7yr hold make the EC-to-private re-rating un-monetizable inside the horizon.
history.rating_rationale: Verified: (1) project sold out with recent prints ~$1,568 psf / $2.29M avg — this $1,397 psf listing sits ~12% below the project own trend, a v3.6 verify-first stale/bait flag on a sold-out development; (2) HDB EC rules: no subsale pre-TOP, pre-MOP resale only to new-EC-eligible buyers, no whole-unit rental during MOP — an investor owning any other property cannot even legally buy this unit; (3) MOP ends ~Mar 2032, so a 2026 buyer has zero rental income and no exit until year ~6 (SC/PR-only until year 10) — the hold-horizon math fails regardless of price; (4) the prior Buy rested on EC-to-private re-rating (real historical pattern) plus Tengah/JRL transformation, but v3.5 backtests show transformation narratives have no measured forward power, and the re-rating only pays after MOP, outside the window. Cheap-vs-peers is the one valid signal here and it cannot be monetized. Algo 412 (below threshold) directionally agrees.
red_flags: EC pre-MOP: cannot sell at all until ~Mar 2032 (5yr from TOP) — exit blocked inside the 5-7yr hold window
No whole-unit rental during MOP — zero yield for ~6 years; owner occupation required
Buyer must meet new-EC eligibility (SC family nucleus, $16k income ceiling, no other property) — most investors ineligible to transact
Listing at $1,397 psf is ~12% below the sold-out project own recent prints (~$1,568) — likely stale/bait price (v3.6 verify-first)
SC/PR-only resale pool years 6-10; full privatization only ~2037
1.34km to Tengah Park MRT (JRL) — not a walk-up station
catalysts: EC-to-private price re-rating post-MOP (~2032) — real pattern, but pays outside the hold horizon
Tengah new-town buildout / JRL completion — narrative only, no backtested forward power (v3.5)
OCR region carries the strongest realized forward appreciation (+3.7%/yr) — accrues to whoever can actually hold to 2032+
